execution_boundary: No funded orders. These are proposals, not implemented empirical studies or established novel contributions.
common_requirements: Inspect nearest related primary research before claiming novelty.
Define event groups, information cutoffs, target, baseline and evaluation split before observing final results.
Separate measurement validity, forecast quality and executable trading value.
Keep uncertainty assumptions, trial history, coverage and negative results visible.
Do not substitute synthetic or demo fills for empirical execution evidence.

hypotheses.name: Resolution-aware payout forecasting
hypotheses.question: Does an explicitly modeled payout process or observable-rule abstention policy improve forecasts at comparable coverage?
hypotheses.baseline: Ordinary event forecast plus a fixed rule-completeness checklist.
hypotheses.evaluation: Future event-grouped payout scores, exceptional-state calibration and comparable coverage; costs evaluated separately.
hypotheses.falsification: No improvement over the simple baseline, or improvements disappear at comparable coverage.
hypotheses.stop: Historical rules cannot be reconstructed without future information.

hypotheses.name: Uncertainty-aware contract consistency
hypotheses.question: Do audited payoff relationships improve forecast coherence or reject false trading candidates?
required_data: Executable prices and size for any trading interpretation
hypotheses.baseline: Independent forecasts and a separate headline-similarity candidate scanner.
hypotheses.evaluation: Future event-grouped forecast scores and separately false-candidate rate, audit effort and cost-covered basket feasibility.
hypotheses.falsification: Projection fails to improve held-out scores or audited scanning offers no useful benefit over simple checks.
hypotheses.stop: Relationship, full outcome space, size, fees or simultaneous execution assumptions cannot be justified.

hypotheses.name: Fill-conditioned probability calibration
hypotheses.question: Does modeling payout conditional on a quote filling improve adverse-selection assessment?
required_data: Authorized decision and fill logs or explicitly synthetic simulation
hypotheses.baseline: Unconditional forecast and simple quote-distance/horizon stratification.
hypotheses.evaluation: Future event-grouped fill and conditional-payout metrics within supported actions; policy value only if identifiable.
hypotheses.falsification: No advantage over stratification, or results fail outside memorized event identities or behavior-policy conditions.
hypotheses.stop: Passive price observations or synthetic fills are the only basis for an asserted empirical execution effect.

hypotheses.name: Information value under latency and capital lockup
hypotheses.question: Does additional information change feasible decisions enough to cover acquisition, quote response and capital costs?
required_data: Quotes and depth after realistic latency
hypotheses.baseline: No-additional-source policy under the same executable-cost and capacity rules.
hypotheses.evaluation: Separate forecast-score gain, changed decisions, retained executable margin and capital usage.
hypotheses.falsification: Incremental modeled decision value is absorbed by information expense, quote response or capital commitment.
hypotheses.stop: Retrospective source timestamps cannot establish actual availability.

hypotheses.name: Hierarchical transfer with abstention
hypotheses.question: Can prespecified related event families improve sparse-family forecasts without unjustified confidence under change?
hypotheses.baseline: Fully pooled, unpooled and reference-rate forecasts with comparable abstention budgets.
hypotheses.evaluation: Chronological event-grouped and held-out-family scores with coverage-performance curves.
hypotheses.falsification: Gains vanish on new families, depend on easy-family weighting, or retain narrow uncertainty during known changes.
hypotheses.stop: Family construction, abstention thresholds or priors were selected using final evaluation outcomes.
